newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - June 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - June 25.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Police seize six million mandrax pills, arrest Asian gang making the drugs.
- Officials recommend that the number of UAE nationals working in banks be increased by four percent a year.
- Abu Dhabi awards Italy's Snamprogetti condensate deal.
- Rules for jobs in banks to change, more nationls to be employed.
- Dubai police chief says drug cases handled by police are only the tip of the iceberg.
- Saudi Arabia aims to stop OPEC quota busting.
- UAE tops the list of oil exporters to Japan, Japanese study says.
- Dubai Islamic Bank invests 110 million dirhams in residential and commercial projects.
